shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!'"\\.next' /workspace / 2>/dev/null | head -80 && printf '\\nWorkspace files:\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!'"\\.next' | head -100 && printf '\\nRoot listing:\\n' && ls -la"

/bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\nInstalled packages:\\n' && ls node_modules | head -80 && printf '\\nGit status:\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\nIgnore rules:\\n' && cat .gitignore && printf '\\nNode versions:\\n' && node --version && npm --version && printf '\\nAncestor instructions:\\n' && for file in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if test -f \""'$file"; then echo "$file"; cat "$file"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -c 'npm view next version && npm view react version && npm view lucide-react version'

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\nPackage versions:\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\nBrowsers available:\\n' && (command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || true)"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: .gitignore
@@
 node_modules/
 __agent_eval__/
+.next/
+.env.local
*** End Patch
PATCH
printf '\\nLockfile header:\\n' && head -35 package-lock.json && printf '\\nGit status:\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "set -e
printf 'Home (empty shelf): '
curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/ | rg -o 'Your next chapter starts here\\.' | head -1
BOOK_ID="'$(BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/dogear-smoke-books.json node --input-type=module -e '"'import { addBook } from \"./lib/books.js\"; const book = await addBook({ title: \"Smoke Test Book\", author: \"Sample Author\", notes: \"A memorable note.\", status: \"reading\" }); console.log(book.id)')
printf 'Home (added book): '
curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/ | rg -o 'Smoke Test Book' | head -1
printf 'Book page: '
curl -fsS \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'$BOOK_ID" | rg -o '"'A memorable note\\.' | head -1
printf 'Direct link status: '
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'$BOOK_ID"
printf '"'Unknown book status: '
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:3000/books/unknown
printf 'Persisted file: '
node -e 'const books = require(\"/tmp/dogear-smoke-books.json\"); console.log("'`${books.length} book, ${books[0].status}`)'"'
rm /tmp/dogear-smoke-books.json"
/bin/bash -c "npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && printf '\\nTracked changes:\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\nWhitespace check:\\n' && git diff --check"
